_comment: RETURN_TO_HAND returned THIS card -- the source -- and read no target, so 'return THE BANISHED CARD to ITS OWNER's hand' returned Send Packing to the CASTER's hand. It is the card this attack banished -- the ref BANISH now records -- and it goes back to its owner, who is the opponent. Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
